purpose: Formal feedback loop pattern for every CYNIC runtime component. Observation -> Evaluation -> Action -> Proof -> Learning. No component is complete without all five stages.

definitions.stage_1_observation: Capture real-time state of a component (health, metrics, logs). Source: cynic-node health checks, cynic-host probes, systemd status.
definitions.stage_2_evaluation: Compare observed state against desired state (declared in contracts/registry). Detect drift, degradation, or failure.
definitions.stage_3_action: Apply bounded mutation to reconcile drift. Mutations are admitted (lease-guarded, human-approved where required).
definitions.stage_4_proof: Read-back verification that the action produced the expected effect. Evidence persisted.
definitions.stage_5_learning: Adjust thresholds, difficulty, or models based on accumulated history. Prevents stale configuration.

proof.failure_action: retry once, then escalate to operator

builder.observation: make check time, build success rate, CPU/RAM/disk
builder.learning_target: difficulty (how many builds/day we can sustain), energy budget, timeout thresholds

network_mesh.learning_target: keepalive interval, watchdog thresholds, route optimization

source_relay.observation: push latency, SHA match success, credential age

no_stale_config.rule: Any threshold or parameter that has not been updated in 30 days must be flagged as stale.
no_stale_config.action: alert operator, fall back to last-known-good or default with explicit marking
